name: What is the process for an exterior surface condition assessment?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for an exterior surface condition assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically involves scheduling an appointment, followed by a thorough on-site inspection by a trained technician. The technician will examine the roof, siding, windows, and other exterior elements, often taking photos and notes. Afterward, you will receive a comprehensive report detailing findings, recommended repairs, and estimated costs. For Discounted Roofing Co., our assessment process includes a detailed photographic log, which is crucial for insurance claims.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves scheduling an appointment, an on-site inspection, and then you receive a detailed report with recommendations and costs.
